The '''unidentified Padawan''' was a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who served under [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Denfa]] during the [[third Galactic War]]. Both the apprentice and their master were slain on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] during [[Mission to Onderon (3627 BBY)|the conflict there]].<ref name="Onslaught" />
{{Char-stub}}

==Powers and abilities==
The Padawan was proficient in using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and was able to use [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force Push]] and [[Force Shockwave]]. He could also use the Force to [[Force healing/Legends|heal]] himself if injured in battle.<ref name="Onslaught" />
